title: Canonical decay/revalidation semantics
root_cause: Learning decay updates pipeline state without marking canonical knowledge or its dependents suspect.
source_requirement: Preserve historical canon while making decayed knowledge revalidation-required and transitively invalidating dependents.
implementation_steps: Trigger dependency invalidation when decay crosses policy.
Keep historical canonical bytes browsable with explicit status.
negative_cases: Decayed head used as current authority.
affected_tests: Knowledge browser, routing eligibility, evidence freshness tests.
evidence_required: Lifecycle receipt proving suspect state, transitive invalidation, and non-deletion.
rollback: Remove new status projections and hooks without deleting canonical history.
acceptance_criteria: All revision-bound dependents become stale until fresh validation.
